args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and first aid kit
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat and sunglasses
- Rain jacket or small umbrella (for unexpected showers)

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Water shoes (for rocky beaches)

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Hiking socks
- Moisture-wicking shirts
- Quick-dry pants/shorts
- Daypack/backpack
- Insect repellent
- Sun protection (hat, sunglasses, sunscreen)

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor visit: Respectful attire
- Luau: Hawaiian shirt or dress (optional but fun)
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Shopping: Reusable shopping bags

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Portable power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Headphones

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader for beach reading
- Travel pillow for flights
- Snacks for travel days
- Small backpack for daily excursions
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes
